findings.evidence_quote_or_span: private var accessToken: String; accessToken = try await auth.refresh()
findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Token reads/writes and refresh publication are unsynchronized, so concurrent requests can race or publish inconsistent credentials.
findings.recommended_change: Serialize auth state and refresh operations behind an actor or equivalent single-owner contract.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Confirmed for concurrent use; no serialization guarantee is shown.

findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Local invalidation occurs only after an external await, allowing an in-flight send to refresh or retry after logout.
findings.recommended_change: Invalidate local session/generation before awaiting remote logout and cancel or reject prior-generation work.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Applies when logout is a session boundary; no such ordering is shown.

findings.evidence_quote_or_span: return try await transport.send(request, accessToken: accessToken)
findings.why_it_is_a_defect: 401 replay lacks an explicit replay-safety/idempotency contract and may duplicate side effects.
findings.recommended_change: Require endpoint replay safety/idempotency or restrict replay to proven-safe requests.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Conditional contract gap; the control permits retry when safety is guaranteed.

controls_not_defects: One retry after 401 is valid when backend rotation and replay safety are explicitly guaranteed.
unknowns: Actor usage, refresh single-flight behavior, logout boundary, and request/backend idempotency are unspecified.
